limitations: Mocked protocol execution does not establish rendering, codecs/devices, platform capture behavior, live streaming, or real OBS performance.
A finite watchdog expiration records that no bounded response was observed; it does not prove an indefinite hang.
The disconnect probe closes before applying an idempotent scene setter; it cannot establish behavior after an applied non-idempotent mutation.

result.instructions:
Control OBS Studio via obs-websocket v5. Requires OBS Studio running with Tools > WebSocket Server Settings enabled. Connection defaults to localhost:4455 with no password — override with OBS_HOST/OBS_PORT/OBS_PASSWORD environment variables if yours differs.

Scene and source names are case-sensitive and must match exactly what's shown in OBS. Use get_scene_list / get_input_list to see exact names before acting on them.

tools.name: set_current_scene_collection

tools.name: create_scene_collection

tools.name: get_profile_list
tools.description: List all profiles and the currently active one.

tools.name: set_current_profile
tools.description: Switch to a profile by name.

tools.name: remove_profile
tools.description: Remove a profile. If it's the active one, OBS switches away first.

tools.description:
Read a raw parameter from the current profile's .ini configuration.

tools.name: set_profile_parameter

tools.name: set_video_settings

tools.name: get_stream_service_settings

tools.name: get_record_directory

Set the output directory recordings are written to.

tools.name: get_source_filter_kind_list

List every filter kind this OBS install supports (noise_suppress_filter,
        noise_gate_filter, compressor_filter, color_filter, chroma_key_filter, etc).

tools.name: get_source_filter_list

List all filters on a source (input or scene), in chain order.

            source_name: Name of the source.

tools.name: get_source_filter_default_settings

tools.name: create_source_filter
tools.description:
Add a new filter to a source.

            filter_name: Name for the new filter.

tools.description: Rename a filter.

Reorder a filter within a source's filter chain.

Configure a filter's parameters.

tools.name: get_version

OBS/obs-websocket version info, platform, and the full list of requests

tools.name: get_stats

Live perf stats: CPU/memory usage, active FPS, render/output skipped

Broadcast a CustomEvent to all subscribed obs-websocket clients.

Call a request registered by a third-party OBS plugin/script vendor.

List all hotkey names in OBS. Best-effort — hotkey requests are less

tools.name: clean_audio_input
tools.description:
Set up a standard mic-cleanup filter chain in one call: Noise Gate
        -> Noise Suppression -> Compressor, in that order (order matters —
        gate first cuts room noise between words, suppression reduces steady
        background hiss while you're talking, compressor evens out what's left).

        Skips any filter kind that already exists on the input by that name
        instead of duplicating it. Removing a stage later is a normal
        remove_source_filter call — this only handles the one-shot setup.

        Args:
            input_name: Name of the mic/audio input to clean up.
            gate/suppression/compressor: Which stages to add (all on by default).
            gate_open_threshold_db: Gate opens above this level. Should sit
                slightly below your voice level. Default -26 dB.
            gate_close_threshold_db: Gate closes below this level. Should sit
                above the room's noise floor, 5-8 dB below open threshold.
                Default -32 dB.
            suppression_method: "rnnoise" (better quality, default) or "speex"
                (lighter weight, older).
            compressor_ratio: Compression ratio, 1.0-32.0. Default 3.0 (gentle).
            compressor_threshold_db: Level compression kicks in at, -60..0 dB.
                Default -18 dB.

tools.name: diagnose_av_health
tools.description:
Diagnose why a stream/recording might be dropping frames or stuttering
        — pulls GetStats + GetStreamStatus + GetRecordStatus in one call and
        interprets the ratios instead of leaving the AI to fetch three things
        and do the arithmetic itself.

        The three numbers that actually matter, and what each one means:
        - renderSkippedFrames/renderTotalFrames high: OBS's render thread can't
          keep up with your scene (too many sources/filters, canvas resolution
          too high, or GPU-bound). Fix: lower canvas resolution, cut filters,
          simplify the scene.
        - outputSkippedFrames/outputTotalFrames high with LOW congestion:
          encoding can't keep up (CPU/GPU encoder overloaded). Fix: switch to
          a hardware encoder (NVENC/AMF/QSV), lower the encoder preset, or
          lower output resolution/fps.
        - outputCongestion high: the network can't keep up with your bitrate.
          Fix: lower bitrate, check upload speed.

        These thresholds are heuristics, not authoritative OBS cutoffs — a
        few skipped frames right after starting a stream is normal; this
        flags *sustained* skip ratios worth investigating, not noise.

tools.name: get_scene_item_list
tools.description: List every scene item (placed source) in a scene.

tools.name: get_group_scene_item_list
tools.description:
Like get_scene_item_list, but for a group (OBS groups are broken
        under the hood — prefer nested scenes over groups where possible).

tools.description:
Find a scene item's numeric ID by the source name it references.

        Args:
            scene_name: Scene or group to search.
            source_name: Name of the source to find.
            search_offset: Matches to skip. -1 = last (topmost) match.

tools.name: get_scene_item_source
tools.description: Get the source name/UUID a scene item references.

tools.name: create_scene_item
tools.description:
Add an existing source to a scene as a new scene item.

        Args:
            scene_name: Scene to add the item to.
            source_name: Existing source (input) to place.
            scene_item_enabled: Whether it starts visible.

tools.name: remove_scene_item
tools.description: Remove a scene item from a scene (does not delete the underlying source).

tools.name: duplicate_scene_item
tools.description:
Duplicate a scene item, copying its transform/crop, optionally into
        a different scene.

        Args:
            scene_name: Scene the item is currently in.
            scene_item_id: Numeric ID of the item to duplicate.
            destination_scene_name: Target scene; defaults to the source scene.

tools.name: get_scene_item_transform
tools.description: Get a scene item's position, scale, rotation, and crop.

tools.name: set_scene_item_transform
tools.description:
Set a scene item's position/scale/rotation/crop.

        Args:
            scene_name: Scene the item is in.
            scene_item_id: Numeric ID of the item.
            transform: Object with any of positionX/positionY, rotation,
                scaleX/scaleY, alignment, boundsType/boundsAlignment/
                boundsWidth/boundsHeight, cropLeft/Right/Top/Bottom.

tools.name: get_scene_item_enabled
tools.description: Get whether a scene item is currently visible (shown/hidden, not mute).

tools.name: set_scene_item_enabled
tools.description:
Show or hide a scene item.

        Args:
            scene_name: Scene the item is in.
            scene_item_id: Numeric ID of the item.
            enabled: True = visible, False = hidden.

tools.name: get_scene_item_locked
tools.description: Get a scene item's lock state (locked items can't be moved/resized in the UI).

tools.name: set_scene_item_locked
tools.description: Lock or unlock a scene item.

tools.name: get_scene_item_index
tools.description: Get a scene item's stacking position (0 = bottom of the source list).

tools.name: set_scene_item_index
tools.description:
Reorder a scene item's stacking position (z-order).

        Args:
            scene_name: Scene the item is in.
            scene_item_id: Numeric ID of the item.
            index: New position, >= 0 (0 = bottom of the source list).

tools.name: get_scene_item_blend_mode
tools.description: Get a scene item's blend mode.

tools.name: set_scene_item_blend_mode
tools.description:
Set a scene item's blend mode.

        Args:
            scene_name: Scene the item is in.
            scene_item_id: Numeric ID of the item.
            blend_mode: One of OBS_BLEND_NORMAL, _ADDITIVE, _SUBTRACT, _SCREEN,
                _MULTIPLY, _LIGHTEN, _DARKEN.

tools.name: get_canvas_list
tools.description:
List all canvases in OBS (multi-canvas is a newer OBS feature; most
        setups only have the main canvas).

tools.name: get_scene_list
tools.description: List every scene, plus the current program and preview scene names.

tools.name: get_group_list
tools.description: List all groups (OBS treats groups as a special kind of scene).

tools.name: get_current_program_scene
tools.description: The scene currently live on Program (what viewers see).

tools.name: set_current_program_scene
tools.description:
Switch the live Program scene — the core "cut to this scene" action.

        Args:
            scene_name: Exact scene name (see get_scene_list).

tools.name: get_current_preview_scene
tools.description: The scene currently loaded in Preview. Only meaningful in studio mode.

tools.name: set_current_preview_scene
tools.description:
Load a scene into Preview (studio mode only) — stage it before
        transitioning to Program with trigger_studio_mode_transition.

        Args:
            scene_name: Exact scene name.

tools.name: create_scene
tools.description:
Create a new, empty scene.

        Args:
            scene_name: Name for the new scene.

tools.name: remove_scene
tools.description:
Delete a scene.

        Args:
            scene_name: Name of the scene to remove.

tools.name: set_scene_name
tools.description:
Rename a scene.

        Args:
            scene_name: Current name of the scene.
            new_scene_name: New name.

tools.name: get_scene_transition_override
tools.description:
Get the transition overridden for a specific scene, if any.

        Args:
            scene_name: Name of the scene.

tools.name: set_scene_transition_override

Override which transition (and/or duration) is used when switching

        Args:
            scene_name: Name of the scene.
            transition_name: Transition to use, or None to clear the override.

tools.name: get_source_active
tools.description:
Check whether a source (input or scene) is currently showing in

Get a Base64-encoded screenshot of a source (input or scene) — use

tools.name: save_source_screenshot

Save a screenshot of a source (input or scene) directly to disk.

            image_file_path: Absolute path to save to, e.g. C:/renders/shot.png.
            image_format: e.g. "png", "jpg".
            image_width/image_height: Optional scale-to-fit dimensions (8-4096).
            image_compression_quality: 0 (max compression) to 100 (uncompressed),
                -1 for format default.

tools.description: Enable or disable studio mode.

tools.description: Open an input's Properties dialog in the OBS UI.

tools.description: Open an input's Filters dialog in the OBS UI.

tools.name: open_input_interact_dialog
tools.description: Open an input's Interact dialog in the OBS UI.

tools.name: get_monitor_list
tools.description: List connected monitors (for opening a projector on one).

tools.name: open_video_mix_projector
tools.description:
Open a fullscreen or windowed projector for Preview/Program/Multiview.

        Args:
            video_mix_type: OBS_WEBSOCKET_VIDEO_MIX_TYPE_PREVIEW, _PROGRAM, or _MULTIVIEW.
            monitor_index: Monitor to open fullscreen on (see get_monitor_list),
                -1 for windowed.
            projector_geometry: Qt-base64 window geometry for windowed mode;
                mutually exclusive with monitor_index.

tools.name: open_source_projector
tools.description:
Open a fullscreen or windowed projector for a specific source.

        Args:
            source_name: Name of the source (input or scene).
            monitor_index: Monitor to open fullscreen on, -1 for windowed.
            projector_geometry: Qt-base64 window geometry for windowed mode.
